title: What About Action?
author: Diego Nava
notes: Dance-pop / tech house, 120.993 BPM, Ab minor, full bandwidth (20.5 kHz), side/mid -10 dB. An 8-bar breakdown (-8..-13 dB) builds into a drop whose downbeat transient sits at 63.455 s (+17 dB in 20 ms); bars run 1.9836 s from it. Chosen from 259 Mixkit tracks: earshot rank (3 launch-music descriptions) put it #3 overall, earshot describe reads its drop as 'energetic and driving', 'celebratory and joyful', techno / tech house; the previous pick (Kraft Twerk) read as minimal techno, near-mono (side/mid -25 dB). Runner-ups: mk-740 'Dance Zero' (Lily J), mk-555 'South Waves' (Eugenio Mininni).
